clauses.text: 3.3 A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including VAT, is £50,000 or less.

clauses.text: Cause: a DIR order's gross value is above the direct-order limit. Remedy: raise a purchase request on PUR-PR-01, get it approved, then raise a STD order against it.

clauses.status: not yet in force: applies from 2026-12-01

clauses.document: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3

clauses.text: A DIR order is refused on Save if its gross value is above the direct-order limit configured for your company (shipped default £50,000), with ERR-PO-0610. Raise a purchase request instead. A DIR order may not refer to a request (ERR-PO-0611).
